defects: KNEES_CROSSED: hipAbductL/R=+20 (positive=adduction/inward per integrator-verified sign) → leftKnee.x=+0.017, rightKnee.x=-0.017 (crossed centerline). Description says "knees open comfortably apart" (abduction, outward).

HANDS_NOT_BEHIND: shoulderFwdL/R=-10 (negative=forward per integrator-verified sign) → wrist z=+0.19/0.19 (forward of torso z=+0.021). Description says "Place both hands behind you on the tube edge". Hands must be posterior (z<0).
SHOULDER_ABDUCTION_EXCESS: L 35°, R 47° abducted; hands resting on tube edge should be near body (~15°).

SWEEP_FALSE_POSITIVE: hand_to_chin flag triggered by regex matching "lift the chin with" in description — phrase refers to chin position, NOT a hand-to-chin contact. No semantic claim of hand-to-chin.
failing_tests: expect(leftKnee.x).toBeLessThan(leftHip.x) — left knee should be lateral to left hip (open), not crossed past centerline
expect(rightKnee.x).toBeGreaterThan(rightHip.x) — right knee should be lateral to right hip (open)
expect(leftWrist.z).toBeLessThan(leftShoulder.z) — wrist posterior to shoulder when hands behind
regression_risk: Low — change is field-level joints only, no renderer change. Spine=-10 (backward arch, correct for slight backward lean), globalTilt=+10 preserved (rig positioning). Risk: if globalTilt=+10 was actually forward-tilt compensation for tube, no change needed; if it was wrong, a future globalTilt fix would address it.
rationale: CORRECTED sign conventions: hipAbduct + = adduction (inward/cross), - = abduction (outward/spread). shoulderFwd + = behind (posterior), - = forward (anterior). Description requires knees OPEN (abduction → negative hipAbduct) and hands BEHIND (posterior → positive shoulderFwd). Reduced shoulder abduction from 35°/47° to ~15°/18° so wrists rest near hip-level on tube edge instead of far out to sides. Original config had both signs INVERTED vs description, producing knees-crossed + hands-forward — a 2-axis contact failure. The hand_to_chin sweep flag is a regex false positive (matched "chin with" in lift-the-chin phrase); actual wrist→head distances are 0.94/0.98 (very far from chin).
